Letter Spacing Tuner

Fine-tune CSS letter-spacing on live sample text — slider in px and em, with font-size control and copyable CSS.

DESIGN WITH SPACE

📖 How to use

  1. Edit the sample text to your own headline.
  2. Drag the letter-spacing slider (negative values tighten, positive loosen).
  3. Adjust font size to judge the spacing at real scale, then copy the CSS.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is letter-spacing?

The CSS property that adds or removes space between characters (called "tracking" in print design). Positive values air text out; negative values tighten it.

When should I change it?

All-caps headlines usually need +0.05em to +0.15em; large display type often looks better slightly tightened; body text is best left at normal.

px or em — which unit?

em scales with font size, so it stays proportional if the text size changes. The tool shows both values live.
